description: Service header: the real-time board's U0TXD, U0RXD, GND, EN and IO0
notes: FIVE PINS (ADR 0018): 1 TXD (IO43, out, through R-TXD-SER), 2 RXD (IO44, in), 3 GND, 4 EN, 5 IO0 - the ground between the UART pair and the control pair. EN and IO0 reach it on two conductors of CBL-MCU-RIBBON, soldered on the Matrix to its Key1 (RESET/EN) and Key2 (BOOT/IO0) terminals. NOTHING IN SERIES ON EN OR IO0 (TXD has R-TXD-SER, EN has C-EN to ground): the Matrix pulls both up with 10k to its 3V3 (R8, R10) and its buttons pull them to GND [datasheets/mechanical/WAVESHARE-ESP32-S3-MATRIX-SCHEMATIC.pdf]. DRIVE THEM TO GROUND ONLY - a button, a jumper, or an adapter's open-collector reset circuit; never drive them high, least of all from a 5V adapter. Recovery order: USB-Serial-JTAG through the tail USB-C first, a reflash over the same port second, this header third - and with EN and IO0 here, download mode can be forced in place (firmware/README.md)

description: Series resistor on U0TXD (IO43) to HDR-SERVICE pin 1
notes: AT J-MCU PIN 22, the first part on IO43 after the ribbon, then on to HDR-SERVICE pin 1. Espressif's value: 'It is recommended to connect a 499 Ohm series resistor to the U0TXD line to suppress harmonics' [ds datasheets/logic/ESP-HARDWARE-DESIGN-GUIDELINES-ESP32S3.pdf p.16]; it also limits the current a strike on the header pin can push into IO43. UNI-ROYAL 0805W8F4990T5E, LCSC C17722 (JLC extended)

description: EN (CHIP_PU) delay capacitor, EN to ground
notes: AT J-MCU PIN 24, from EN to the ground beside it. With the Matrix's R8 (10k to its 3V3) it is Espressif's RC on CHIP_PU, 'usually R = 10 kOhm and C = 1 uF' [ds datasheets/logic/ESP-HARDWARE-DESIGN-GUIDELINES-ESP32S3.pdf p.11]: tau 10 ms, past the 50 us t_STBL [ds datasheets/logic/ESP32-S3-datasheet-v2.2.pdf Table 2-13 p.30], and a filter on the long EN conductor (ribbon plus this board to HDR-SERVICE). Key1, a jumper or an open-collector reset still pulls it low at once. The C-SENSOR-VS-BULK part: CL21B105KBFNNNE, LCSC C28323 (JLC basic)
